headline: Silver Touch Technologies declares Rs 0.10 interim dividend
hook: Small payout by Silver Touch Technologies
summary: Silver Touch Technologies announced an interim dividend of Rs 0.10 per equity share following its board meeting on October 29, 2026. This corporate action returns a small amount of capital directly to the company's existing shareholders. Retail investors holding the stock on the record date will receive the payout. The dividend provides minor cash flow for retail shareholders.
why_it_matters: Minor dividend credited to your account

headline: Silver Touch Technologies reports September quarter financial results
summary: Silver Touch Technologies Limited has submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing details the company's financial performance during the second quarter of the fiscal year. Retail investors can review these numbers to assess the company's revenue growth, profitability, and operational health.
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers reveal earnings trajectory for shareholders.
